title: Typed-Centrality Grounding for Agentic GraphRAG: A Symbolic Approach for Agentic Reasoning
title_zh: 面向智能体GraphRAG的类型化中心性落地：一种用于智能体推理的符号化方法

paragraphs.en: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) represent two approaches for knowledge representation and reasoning over heterogeneous data. Recent research has explored their integration through Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) systems, which use KGs to provide structured context to LLMs. However, existing GraphRAG approaches treat KGs as homogeneous graphs and rely on textual similarity between the input prompt and the context, rather than using it as a source of deterministic knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 知识图谱（KG）与大语言模型（LLM）代表了在异构数据上进行知识表示与推理的两种方法。 近期研究已通过图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）系统探索了二者的融合，该系统利用知识图谱为大语言模型提供结构化上下文。 然而，现有的 GraphRAG 方法将知识图谱视为同构图，并依赖输入提示与上下文之间的文本相似性，而不是将其作为确定性知识的来源。

sents.zh: 然而，现有的 GraphRAG 方法将知识图谱视为同构图，并依赖输入提示与上下文之间的文本相似性，而不是将其作为确定性知识的来源。

paragraphs.en: This work proposes an agent-based GraphRAG system that introduces a symbolic layer to integrate deterministic reasoning alongside text similarities. This approach is based on the definition of typed centralities for KGs, where centrality measures are computed separately for each specific KG’s class. This information is used to construct a symbolic representation that is provided to the LLM as a deterministic source. The proposed system was mathematically validated and evaluated on a real-world POLE (Person, Object, Location, Event) dataset, comparing reasoning and information retrieval with and without the symbolic layer. The results indicate that the our approach leads to responses that are more consistent with the context, improving the generated outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作提出了一种基于智能体的 GraphRAG 系统，引入符号层以将确定性推理与文本相似度相结合。 该方法基于知识图谱（KG）类型化中心性的定义，其中中心性度量是针对知识图谱的每个特定类分别计算的。 这些信息被用于构建符号表示，作为确定性来源提供给大语言模型（LLM）。 所提出的系统经过了数学验证，并在一个真实的 POLE（人物、物体、地点、事件）数据集上进行了评估，比较了有符号层和无符号层情况下的推理与信息检索效果。 结果表明，我们的方法能够生成与上下文更加一致的回答，从而提升了生成输出的质量。

paragraphs.en: In order to get value from large-scale heterogeneous data, research is increasingly moving toward knowledge-based approaches for structured representation and AI-based methodologies for data processing [ 1 ] . Knowledge Graphs (KGs) are graph-based data structures that represent different types of nodes and relationships using labels to describe their nature. They combine the principles of graph theory with the semantic meaning of labels to extract information from data [ 2 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了从大规模异构数据中获取价值，研究正日益转向基于知识的方法进行结构化表示，以及基于人工智能的方法进行数据处理 [1]。 知识图谱（Knowledge Graphs，KGs）是一种基于图的数据结构，通过使用标签来描述不同类型的节点和关系的性质。 它们将图论原理与标签的语义含义相结合，从而从数据中提取信息 [2]。

paragraphs.en: While KGs use a deterministic strategy, Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as an AI-based probabilistic approach. LLMs work through statistical distributions learned from sequences of tokens, linking the input prompt to the knowledge acquired during extensive pre-training [ 3 ] . Both approaches have shown great effectiveness in the analysis of heterogeneous data, achieving significant results in areas such as healthcare and finance [ 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 知识图谱采用确定性策略，而大语言模型（LLMs）已成为一种基于人工智能的概率方法。 大语言模型通过从 token 序列中学习到的统计分布进行工作，将输入提示词与大规模预训练期间获取的知识相联系 [ 3 ] 。 两种方法在异构数据分析方面都展现出极大的有效性，在医疗和金融等领域取得了显著成果 [ 4 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The recent literature aims to combine the deterministic rigor of KGs with the probabilistic approach of LLMs, with the aim of improving information analysis over data [ 5 ] . In this context, Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) has emerged as one of the most effective hybrid mechanisms to link these two strategies, allowing LLM responses to be grounded in a structured context provided by the KG [ 6 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的文献旨在将知识图谱的确定性严谨性与大语言模型的概率化方法相结合，以改进对数据的分析 [ 5 ] 。 在此背景下，图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）已成为连接这两种策略最有效的混合机制之一，使大语言模型的回答能够建立在知识图谱所提供的结构化上下文之上 [ 6 ] 。

sents.en: The recent literature aims to combine the deterministic rigor of KGs with the probabilistic approach of LLMs, with the aim of improving information analysis over data [ 5 ] .
sents.zh: 近期的文献旨在将知识图谱的确定性严谨性与大语言模型的概率化方法相结合，以改进对数据的分析 [ 5 ] 。

sents.en: In this context, Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) has emerged as one of the most effective hybrid mechanisms to link these two strategies, allowing LLM responses to be grounded in a structured context provided by the KG [ 6 ] .

paragraphs.en: Despite the high capabilities demonstrated by GraphRAG systems in complex reasoning and information retrieval, they inherit many of the limitations of the two methodologies considered individually [ 7 ] . On the one hand, KGs model reality through deterministic centrality measures that treat the underlying structure as a homogeneous graph, producing values that do not accurately reflect the represented domain [ 8 ] . On the other hand, LLMs’ responses generation is only based on textual similarity between the provided input and the available knowledge, which in GraphRAG systems is represented by the labels on the graph. This leads to the production of semantically plausible but incorrect responses, a phenomenon commonly known as hallucinations [ 9 ] . Therefore, GraphRAG works as a retrieval-enhanced framework where KGs act as additional textual information to augment the LLM, providing supplementary context rather than enforcing a strictly deterministic model of reality.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管GraphRAG系统在复杂推理和信息检索方面展现出很强的能力，但它也继承了单独使用这两种方法时的诸多局限[7]。 一方面，知识图谱通过确定性的中心性度量来建模现实，将底层结构视为同质图，产生的数值并不能准确反映所表示的领域[8]。 另一方面，大语言模型的回答生成仅基于所提供输入与可用知识之间的文本相似性，而在GraphRAG系统中，这些知识是由图上的标签表示的。 这导致产生语义上看似合理但并不正确的回答，这一现象通常被称为幻觉[9]。 因此，GraphRAG作为一个检索增强框架运行，其中知识图谱作为额外的文本信息来增强大语言模型，提供补充性上下文，而非强加一个严格确定性的现实模型。

paragraphs.en: To achieve this full integration, this work proposes a GraphRAG system that addresses their respective limitations. To better model the context from the KG, we introduce the concept of typed centrality, where centrality measures are computed separately for each specific KG’s class. These values are used to build the Symbolic Layer, an additional context that acts as a deterministic base for the GraphRAG system. This allows inference and information retrieval to rely not only on textual similarity but also on symbolic measures. As a result, LLM’s knowledge is grounded in a more accurate context, since the generated responses depend on both probabilistic and deterministic information. This results in: stronger grounding, fewer hallucinations and improved answer explainability.
paragraphs.zh: 为了实现这种全面整合，本工作提出了一个 GraphRAG 系统，以解决它们各自的局限性。 为了更好地建模来自知识图谱的上下文，我们引入了类型化中心性的概念，即针对知识图谱的每个特定类分别计算中心性度量。 这些值被用于构建符号层，这是一个额外的上下文，作为 GraphRAG 系统的确定性基础。 这使得推理和信息检索不仅依赖于文本相似性，还依赖于符号度量。 因此，大语言模型的知识被扎根于更准确的上下文中，因为生成的回答同时依赖于概率性和确定性信息。 这带来了：更强的扎根性、更少的幻觉以及更好的答案可解释性。

The results showed that our integration gave a deterministic anchor to the data, with answers that were more consistent with the given context.

paragraphs.en: The evolution of information retrieval systems has recently shifted toward hybrid architectures, as the research community seeks more robust methodologies to ground generative AI in structured contexts [ 10 ] . Early RAG approaches were introduced to expand LLMs’ knowledge by retrieving external textual information to supplement what was learned during their initial training [ 11 ] . These techniques were further extended through the use of KGs, giving rise to GraphRAG systems that integrate structured knowledge into the LLM [ 12 ] . The transition from standard RAG pipelines to GraphRAG has been facilitated by protocols such as MCP [ 13 ] , which standardize interactions between LLMs and external tools, integrating knowledge retrieval and reasoning directly into the LLM’s decision-making loop. However, most existing implementations retain the classical assumptions of standard RAG pipelines [ 14 ] . Specifically, KGs are traversed to extract textual information from nodes and relationships that are added in the context. Nonetheless, there remains a lack of consideration of the graph structure as a deterministic guide for the inference process [ 15 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 信息检索系统的发展近来已转向混合架构，因为研究界正在寻求更稳健的方法，将生成式人工智能建立在结构化情境之中 [ 10 ] 。 早期的 RAG 方法被提出，旨在通过检索外部文本信息来扩展大语言模型的知识，以补充其在初始训练期间所学到的内容 [ 11 ] 。 这些技术进一步通过知识图谱的使用得到扩展，催生了 GraphRAG 系统，将结构化知识整合到大语言模型中 [ 12 ] 。 从标准 RAG 流水线到 GraphRAG 的过渡得到了诸如 MCP [ 13 ] 等协议的推动，这些协议将大语言模型与外部工具之间的交互标准化，将知识检索与推理直接整合到大语言模型的决策循环中。 然而，大多数现有实现仍然保留着标准 RAG 流水线的经典假设 [ 14 ] 。 具体而言，系统会遍历知识图谱，从节点和关系中提取文本信息并将其加入上下文。 尽管如此，人们仍未充分考虑将图结构作为推理过程的确定性引导 [ 15 ] 。

sents.zh: 尽管如此，人们仍未充分考虑将图结构作为推理过程的确定性引导 [ 15 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Within this setting, recent GraphRAG’s benchmarks primarily evaluate the LLM’s ability to select and invoke the correct tools for a specific task [ 16 ] . However, these criteria do not consider whether the information retrieved is actually consistent with the KG’s semantics. This limitation becomes particularly evident in distributed agentic systems, where decisions are made across multiple sequential reasoning steps. As shown in [ 17 ] , a semantic misinterpretation during the early information selection process can propagate through the reasoning chain, leading to outputs that are procedurally valid but grounded in incorrect assumptions.
paragraphs.zh: 在此背景下，近期的 GraphRAG 基准测试主要评估大语言模型为特定任务选择并调用正确工具的能力 [ 16 ] 。 然而，这些标准并未考虑所检索到的信息是否实际上与知识图谱的语义保持一致。 这一局限性在分布式智能体系统中尤为明显，因为在这类系统中，决策需要经过多个顺序推理步骤才能完成。 如 [ 17 ] 所示，在早期的信息选择过程中出现的语义误解可能会沿推理链传播，导致输出的结果在流程上有效，但其依据却是错误的假设。

paragraphs.en: Several works have attempted to partially address this limitation by introducing retrieval criteria based on graph’s properties. For instance, meta-path–based methodologies restrict the search space using predefined sequences of node and relation types [ 18 ] . These methods heavily rely on domain knowledge to define meaningful paths. As a consequence, they struggle to generalize without extensive manual intervention. Other approaches like post-hoc verification methods operate exclusively on final outputs but do not influence intermediate retrieval or planning decisions made during execution [ 19 ] . So, they fail to prevent error propagation during the reasoning chain, making it impossible to get the system back on track once an early mistake occurs. Other studies propose heterogeneous or type-aware node representations that preserve semantic information within embedding spaces [ 20 ] . Nonetheless, these techniques are typically employed as isolated retrieval components and evaluated on supervised tasks such as link prediction or node classification, rather than being integrated into the iterative decision-making loop of an LLM agent.

paragraphs.en: Recent proposals such as [ 21 ] utilize graph neural networks (GNNs) to improve KG retrieval for multi-hop Questions-Answers (QA), but the paths are verbalized and fed to the LLM without embedding semantic constraints into agent reasoning. Similarly, iterative frameworks like KG-IRAG aim to integrate multi-stage retrieval for temporal reasoning, but they do not formalize KG schema information within the agent’s real-time decision loop [ 22 ] . Works such as GRIL [ 23 ] explore joint graph-LLM optimization, reducing dependence on entity annotations, but still treats retrieval and reasoning as separated processes. Other contributions like KG²RAG and K-RagRec [ 24 ] apply graph-guided retrieval to improve coherence and downstream tasks such as recommendation, but they similarly fall short of using deterministic guidance during reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的一些工作（如 [21]）利用图神经网络（GNN）来改进面向多跳问答（QA）的知识图谱检索，但这些方法将路径言语化后直接输入大语言模型（LLM），并未把语义约束嵌入智能体的推理过程。 类似地，KG-IRAG 等迭代式框架旨在整合多阶段检索以支持时间推理，但它们并没有在智能体的实时决策循环中形式化地纳入知识图谱模式信息 [22]。 GRIL [23] 等工作探索了图与大语言模型的联合优化，降低了对实体标注的依赖，但仍将检索与推理视为相互分离的过程。 KG²RAG 和 K-RagRec [24] 等其他工作将图引导检索应用于提升连贯性以及推荐等下游任务，但它们同样未能在推理过程中利用确定性引导。

paragraphs.en: Recent surveys highlight that even if LLM-based agents have the capacity to plan multi-step queries, their actual navigation refers only to global metrics or simple text similarity rather than deep semantic reasoning [ 16 ] . As a result, current GraphRAG systems rely on embedding-based retrieval that treats graph’s paths as unstructured text blocks, prioritizing semantic proximity in a latent vector space [ 25 ] . Some existing approaches attempt to construct contextual information by relying on global centrality measure but this causes a misinterpretation of the KG’s modeled reality [ 26 ] . Specifically, these methods treat all nodes uniformly, losing the semantic diversity of the KG and leading to outputs that are coherent in language but inconsistent with the graph’s organization.
paragraphs.zh: 近期综述强调，即使基于 LLM 的智能体具备规划多步查询的能力，其实际的导航也仅依赖全局指标或简单的文本相似度，而非深层语义推理 [ 16 ] 。 因此，当前的 GraphRAG 系统依赖基于嵌入的检索，将图的路径视为非结构化文本块，优先考虑潜在向量空间中的语义接近度 [ 25 ] 。 一些现有方法尝试依靠全局中心性度量来构建上下文信息，但这会导致对知识图谱所建模现实的误读 [ 26 ] 。 具体而言，这些方法统一对待所有节点，丢失了知识图谱的语义多样性，导致输出在语言上连贯却与图的组织结构不一致。

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, there is currently no complete integration of KGs-based symbolic reasoning with LLM-based approaches. Addressing this gap requires a shift from passive retrieval toward real hybrid approaches. By using KG-based centrality measures for symbolic reasoning, the GraphRAG can actually have a source of deterministic knowledge rather than a simple text concatenation. This enables the combination of the deterministic structure of KGs with the probabilistic nature of LLMs, allowing the data retrieval process to be also grounded on both semantics and graph-modeled reality.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，目前尚无将基于知识图谱的符号推理与基于大语言模型的方法完全集成的方案。 要弥补这一空白，需要从被动检索转向真正的混合方法。 通过使用基于知识图谱的中心性度量进行符号推理，GraphRAG 实际上可以拥有确定性的知识来源，而非简单的文本拼接。 这使得知识图谱的确定性结构能够与大语言模型的概率性本质相结合，使数据检索过程也能同时立足于语义和以图建模的现实。

paragraphs.en: To address the identified limitations, we introduce the Typed-Centrality Grounding for Agentic GraphRAG, a framework that treats KGs as deterministic signals for LLM’s reasoning. This hybrid approach integrates the symbolic nature of KGs in GraphRAGs by redefining centrality measures as a deterministic background. Instead of applying heterogeneous metrics across the entire network, the framework represents centrality as a composition of class-specific measures calculated independently for each node type. This method allows for a coherent characterization of the modeled context by considering the different semantics within the graph. These type-specific metrics are used in the Symbolic Layer, an additional input which acts as a deterministic anchor to ground the GraphRAG inference process. The overall architecture is organized into four layers, spanning from data storage to the reasoning loop (Fig. 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决上述已识别的局限性，我们提出了面向智能体 GraphRAG 的类型化中心性接地框架，该框架将知识图谱视为大语言模型推理的确定性信号。 这种混合方法通过将中心性度量重新定义为确定性背景，把知识图谱的符号特性集成到 GraphRAG 中。 该框架不是在整个网络上应用统一的异构度量，而是将中心性表示为针对每种节点类型独立计算的类特定度量的组合。 这种方法通过考虑图中的不同语义，实现了对所建模上下文的连贯刻画。 这些类型特定的度量被用于符号层，符号层作为一个附加输入，充当确定性锚点，为 GraphRAG 的推理过程提供接地。 整体架构被组织为四层，涵盖从数据存储到推理循环（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: Direct Connection (1-hop): entities with direct connections or self-loops are directly represented as subgraphs.
paragraphs.zh: 直接连接（1跳）：具有直接连接或自环的实体直接表示为子图。

paragraphs.en: Structural Bridges (2-hop): For node types that lack self connections, the system identifies latent associations by treating the schema as a bipartite network. In particular, it uses shared bridge nodes at distance one to perform a one-mode projection between entities of the same type. This mechanism allows us to compute centrality even in the absence of explicit direct links, capturing the connectivity through intermediate common neighbors.
paragraphs.zh: 结构桥接（2跳）：对于缺乏自连接的节点类型，系统将模式视为二部网络来识别潜在关联。 具体而言，系统利用距离为一的共享桥接节点，在同类型实体之间执行单模投影。 该机制使我们即使在缺乏显式直接连接的情况下也能计算中心性，从而捕获通过中间公共邻居实现的连通性。

paragraphs.en: This section describes the experimental setup and evaluation of the Typed-Centrality Grounding framework, focusing on the reasoning comparison between standard GraphRAG with global metrics and type-aware metrics computed via the Symbolic Layer.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍类型化中心性接地（Typed-Centrality Grounding）框架的实验设置与评估，重点比较使用全局指标的标准 GraphRAG 与通过符号层（Symbolic Layer）计算的类型感知指标之间的推理差异。

paragraphs.en: Experiments use the POLE (Person, Object, Location, Event) dataset, derived from open crime data for the Greater Manchester area 1 1 1 https://www.data.police.uk/data/ on Neo4j 1.6.2 (Fig. 2 ). The graph schema consists of several distinct node types representing the entities of the POLE model. The main node class is Person, which is connected to personal identifiers such as Phone (via HAS_PHONE) and Email (via HAS_EMAIL). Social interactions rely on Person self-relationships. Crime nodes define the event context by linking to: people (PARTY_TO), physical entities (INVOLVED_IN), officers (INVESTIGATED_BY) and locations (OCCURRED_AT). Geographical data is hierarchical, connecting Location to PostCode and Area. Finally, communication patterns are captured by the PhoneCall node, which links two Phone nodes via CALLER and CALLED edges.
paragraphs.zh: 实验使用 POLE（Person、Object、Location、Event）数据集，该数据集来源于大曼彻斯特地区的公开犯罪数据 1 1 1 https://www.data.police.uk/data/，并部署在 Neo4j 1.6.2 上（图 2）。 图模式由若干不同的节点类型组成，用于表示 POLE 模型中的各类实体。 主要的节点类别是 Person，它通过 HAS_PHONE 和 HAS_EMAIL 等关系连接到 Phone 和 Email 等个人标识信息节点。 社交互动依赖于 Person 的自关系。 Crime 节点通过以下连接定义事件上下文：人员（PARTY_TO）、物理实体（INVOLVED_IN）、警员（INVESTIGATED_BY）以及地点（OCCURRED_AT）。 地理数据是分层的，将 Location 连接到 PostCode 和 Area。 最后，通信模式由 PhoneCall 节点捕捉，该节点通过 CALLER 和 CALLED 边连接两个 Phone 节点。

paragraphs.en: Signal magnitude restoration addresses the dilution of global metrics observed in high-cardinality nodes, where values such as the Global PageRank for Crime ( ≈ 0.15 \approx 0.15 ) and Global Degree for PostCode ( ≈ 1 \approx 1 ) are significantly suppressed. By implementing typed metrics, the signal magnitude is successfully restored, reaching approximately 0.96 0.96 for Typed PageRank and 292 292 for Typed Degree, reflecting the relevance of these nodes within their specific type-subgraphs (Figs. 3 , 4 ). Topological consistency is further validated through Typed Closeness Centrality, which confirms that the projections result in fully connected subgraphs for both Crime and Location entities (Fig. 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 信号幅值恢复旨在解决高基数节点中全局指标被稀释的问题，例如犯罪（Crime）节点的全局 PageRank（≈ 0.15）与邮编（PostCode）节点的全局度数（≈ 1）被显著压低。 通过实现类型化指标，信号幅值得以成功恢复，类型化 PageRank 达到约 0.96，类型化度数达到 292，反映出这些节点在其特定类型子图中的相关性（图 3、4）。 拓扑一致性进一步通过类型化接近中心性得到验证，该指标证实投影在犯罪（Crime）与位置（Location）实体上均生成了完全连通的子图（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: To test type-agnostic ranking limitations, the agent was prompted:
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试与类型无关的排序局限性，向智能体给出了如下提示：

paragraphs.zh: “使用 neo4j MCP，识别在犯罪网络中充当最关键结构性桥梁的 'PostCode' 实体。”

paragraphs.en: The baseline approach, utilizing global metrics, identifies node WA14 2SP due to its high Global Betweenness ( 38.5 38.5 ) (Fig. 6 ). However, this score is primarily driven by connections to numerous unrelated entities across the KGs, such as Person or Location nodes that lack direct relevance to crime events. Consequently, the global metric is amplified, failing to accurately represent the node’s role as a bridge within the specific crime subgraph.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法利用全局指标识别出节点 WA14 2SP，因为其全局介数中心性很高（38.5 38.5）（图 6）。 然而，该分数主要来源于与知识图谱中大量无关实体的连接，例如与犯罪事件缺乏直接关联的 Person 或 Location 节点。 因此，全局指标被放大，无法准确表示该节点在特定犯罪子图中作为桥梁的作用。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, the typed approach identifies node M1 3EZ as the critical bridge, characterized by a Typed Degree of 114.0 114.0 (Fig. 7 ). By computing centrality exclusively within the Location/Crime subgraph, the Symbolic Layer filters out irrelevant nodes from the computation, ensuring that the centrality scores reflect only real connections. This explains the agent’s selection of M1 3EZ, which emerges as a truly central hub within the subgraph connecting crime events.

paragraphs.en: The second experiment assesses whether type-aware centrality restores meaningful signal magnitude for high-cardinality nodes. The agent was prompted:
paragraphs.zh: 第二个实验评估类型感知中心性是否能恢复高基数节点的有效信号幅度。智能体收到的提示为：

paragraphs.en: “Using neo4j MCP, identify the most influential Crime node based on the importance of its connections within the network structure.”
paragraphs.zh: “使用 neo4j MCP，基于网络结构中连接的重要性，识别最具影响力的 Crime 节点。”

paragraphs.en: The baseline approach, relying on global metrics, ranks node 57116 as the most significant due to its high Global Betweenness ( 68.75 68.75 ) (Fig. 8 ). However, this value is artificially inflated by indirect connections to non-crime entities, a factor that dilutes the actual relevance of the node’s interactions within the Crime subgraph. This difference is evidenced by its Typed Degree of only 36 36 , which indicates that the node’s influence is significantly less pronounced when restricted to crime-specific interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法依赖全局指标，将节点 57116 评为最重要节点，因为其全局介数（ 68.75 68.75 ）很高（图 8 ）。 然而，该数值被与非犯罪实体的间接连接人为夸大，这一因素稀释了该节点的交互在犯罪子图中的实际相关性。 这种差异体现在其类型化度数仅为 36 36 ，这表明当限制在犯罪相关交互时，该节点的影响力明显不那么显著。

paragraphs.en: The experimental results align with the formal validation of the Typed-Centrality Grounding framework. The model validation demonstrated that global centrality metrics in KGs are affected by signal dilution (Lemma IV.1 ). In the first experiment, this effect is evident, as the baseline using global metrics selected node WA14 2SP due to high Global Betweenness, even though its connections were mostly outside the relevant Location/Crime subgraph. The Typed approach, which computes centrality within type-specific subgraphs, correctly identified M1 3EZ as the critical bridge. By working on a subgraph, the signal of relevant nodes is amplified relative to irrelevant nodes (Theorem IV.1 ), allowing the agent to prioritize structurally significant entities.
paragraphs.zh: 实验结果与 Typed-Centrality Grounding 框架的形式化验证相一致。 模型验证表明，知识图谱中的全局中心性指标会受到信号稀释的影响（引理 IV.1）。 在第一个实验中，这种效应十分明显：使用全局指标的基线方法由于 WA14 2SP 节点具有较高的全局中介中心性而选中了它，尽管其连接大多位于相关的地点/犯罪子图之外。 而基于类型的方法在类型特定的子图内计算中心性，正确识别出 M1 3EZ 是关键的桥接节点。 通过在子图上操作，相关节点相对于无关节点的信号被放大（定理 IV.1），使智能体能够优先考虑结构上重要的实体。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we presented a Typed-Centrality Grounding for Agentic GraphRAG, a framework designed to address the limitations of symbolic-agnostic reasoning in GraphRAG systems. By introducing a Symbolic Layer that computes typed centrality metrics within type-specific subgraphs, the framework adds a deterministic grounding to the context. Our approach led to an improved selection of structural hubs, a more accurate ranking of critical nodes, and a clearer identification of subgraph topologies. These symbolic signals guide reasoning and nodes can be better traced by the agent via interpretable typed metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了面向智能体 GraphRAG 的类型化中心性锚定（Typed-Centrality Grounding），这是一个旨在解决 GraphRAG 系统中符号无关推理局限性的框架。 通过引入一个符号层（Symbolic Layer）在类型特定的子图内计算类型化中心性指标，该框架为上下文增加了确定性的锚定。 我们的方法带来了结构枢纽选择的改进、关键节点排序的更准确，以及子图拓扑识别的更清晰。 这些符号信号引导推理过程，并且智能体可以通过可解释的类型化指标更好地追踪节点。

paragraphs.en: In future work, we plan to extend the framework by integrating a neurosymbolic layer that combines typed-centrality measures with graph embeddings. This will allow the agent to use both explicit structural signals and learned semantic representations, supporting richer reasoning over the observed KGs. Overall, the Typed-Centrality Grounding Framework demonstrates that KGs can serve as active, interpretable guides for agentic reasoning. By combining type-aware centrality with a symbolic layer that is fed into the GraphRAG, the framework can provide symbolic-informed support for complex reasoning.
